subject: CL-2-judge: review the Zonoid memory-backend integration
description: SKILL: self-learn-judge single-attempt review mode against CL-2's attempt branch (get_attempt_diff). Apply the code-review rubric to the Zonoid memory adapter: (a) does it correctly implement the FAISS seam's interface (read/write signatures match what the harness calls); (b) does the write path actually compound KB across tasks in a per-sequence workspace (not leak into the live zonoid graph); (c) is the 3-arm toggle clean (OFF/FAISS/Zonoid selectable without code edits); (d) scope discipline + no dead code; (e) is there a smoke check proving the adapter's read/write works against the daemon. APPROVE (hold-merge) if sound; KICK BACK (set_status failed + record_decision wired) if the seam interface is wrong, the workspace isolation is broken, or there's no smoke evidence. Never force-merge.
